name: amfx-claims-vs-unemployment-research
description: amFX reproduction (25OCT22 p1): US Initial Claims vs Unemployment Rate overlay. Both series converted to percentile rankings for a common 0-100 scale. Claims inverted so visual correlation matches (falling claims = falling unemployment). Demonstrates that Initial Claims consistently lead the Unemployment Rate at cycle turns by 3-22 months. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: INITIAL CLAIMS VS UNEMPLOYMENT RATE (25OCT22 p1)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's lead-lag chart showing Initial Claims consistently
# lead the Unemployment Rate at cycle turns.
# =============================================================================

# Initial Jobless Claims (weekly SA, FRED: ICSA)
claims_src = economic_indicators(series_id='ICSA')()
claims = ffill(claims_src.result)

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='US Initial Claims: Do They Lead the Unemployment Rate?',
    category='Claims vs Unemployment',
    y_axis_label='Initial Claims (thousands)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Initial Claims (SA)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=300, title='300K Threshold', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, claims)
